stories.headline: Australian surveillance aircraft feeds intelligence to US and Israel in Middle East conflict

stories.headline: Labor wins South Australian election landslide as One Nation surges past Liberals into second place
stories.summary: Premier Peter Malinauskas led Labor to a decisive second-term victory in South Australia with around 38% of the primary vote. One Nation achieved a historic 22% of votes, overtaking the collapsed Liberal Party at 19% in what analysts called a watershed moment that could signal the end of the two-party system.

stories.headline: Australian Greens reach record membership milestone of 10,000 members
stories.summary: The Australian Greens achieved record-breaking membership numbers, surpassing 10,000 members. The party has long overtaken the Scottish Tories and Liberal Democrats in size and has called for Scottish Labour to publish their membership numbers. The milestone follows various Green policy wins including free bus travel and environmental initiatives.
